name: Gainax Renzoku Satsujin Jiken (Ero)
original_name: ガイナックス連続殺人事件(エロ)
source:
Main character is a new editor who participates in Gainax new game planning meeting in the mountains. However, as soon as team gathers, storm breaks out cutting way back. Meanwhile, Gainax staff members start to get killed one after another. Can protagonist find a criminal and develop special relations with staff girls under these circumstances?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名新编辑，前往山中参加GAINAX的新游戏企划会议。然而，团队刚一集合，暴风雨便袭来，切断了回去的路。与此同时，GAINAX的工作人员开始接连遇害。主人公能否在这种情形下找出凶手，并与团队中的女性发展出特别的关系？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
